title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: scaffolding and hoists
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Podium perimeter scaffold erection and dismantling
swms.task: Erect, alter and dismantle the tube and coupler perimeter scaffold around the podium next to the street, with loading bays.

facts.fallControl: Scaffolders install platforms, edge protection and access at each lift before going higher, and wear harnesses clipped to the scaffold where edge protection is not yet in place.
facts.controlsConsidered: Installing edge protection from the lift below with advance guardrails was considered for every lift; harnesses are used only where the scaffold layout prevents it.
facts.systemInstructions: Tube and coupler scaffold to the scaffold designer's drawings SC-01 (revision B), erected by licensed intermediate scaffolders.

steps: Set up and protect the area below

swms.title: Mobile scaffolds for fit-out trades
swms.task: Erect and move mobile scaffolds for the ceiling and services trades on each floor.

facts.fallControl: Mobile scaffolds have full guardrails and toe boards on every platform, and internal ladders.

swms.title: Builders' hoist installation and climbing
swms.task: Install, climb and dismantle the personnel and materials hoist on the building face, tying it to the slab edges as it climbs.

facts.systemInstructions: The hoist is installed to the manufacturer's manual (model and revision on the plant register) by our crew holding intermediate rigging licences.
facts.fallControl: Riggers work from the hoist car roof inside its guardrails and wear harnesses clipped to the mast anchor points when outside them.

steps: Install, climb and dismantle the hoist

swms.title: Builders' hoist operation
swms.task: Operate the personnel and materials hoist, carrying workers and materials to each floor.

facts.fallControl: Every landing has a full height landing gate that stays closed unless the car is at the landing.

rules.phrase: not used until a competent person gives written confirmation
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 225
rules.quote: written confirmation from a competent person that construction of the scaffold has been completed

rules.phrase: a platform at least 450 mm wide
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 306P
rules.quote: a platform at least 450mm wide along the full length of the section of scaffolding

rules.phrase: registration number is kept at the hoist
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 243, s 260, schedule 5
rules.quote: the design registration number is kept readily accessible in the vicinity of the plant at all times

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 210, s 211
rules.quote: any handle, bar or push button associated with the stop control is coloured red
